fact: The Ministry of ICT and Postal Services invited expressions of interest, closing 30 June 2026, for a consultancy to develop a National Data Governance Strategy, Data Classification Framework, Interoperability Framework and Government Cloud and Data Ecosystem Strategy, over five months.
title: Consulting Service to Design and Develop Data Governance Strategy for the MICT&PS
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services (EA-RDIP)
